lead: `echo "status: ", Core\Command::run()` prints the label before whatever the callee echoes.
body: `echo`'s arguments are written as they are evaluated, so a member that produces output inside the call interleaves with the text around it and the expectation reads `status: greet: Hello...`, which looks like a matcher bug. Take the value into a variable first; every dispatching or callback-taking member has this shape.
